threat_event: Intruder on a gateway session to the Plant C1 EWS changes reactor alarm limits and a chlorine feed setpoint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared integrator team accounts; no per-session approval by the plant; standing hub connection; DCS event journal not reviewed
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-C1; SYS-C2; Plant C1 hypochlorite reactors
existing_controls: MFA on the gateway; sessions recorded; SIS trips on feed ratio and temperature
treatment_plan: Phone approval by the shift superintendent now; named accounts and per-session approval in the gateway; DCS journal to the SIEM

threat_event: Compromise of the central engineering hub pushes malicious logic or recipes to many plants at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hub keeps standing connections to every plant EWS; recipe pushes bypass the plant MOC screen
existing_controls: Hub access limited to Process Control Engineering; EDR on hub workstations
treatment_plan: Remove standing connections; staging share and plant MOC for every push; signed recipe packages
owner: Specialty Chemicals Director of Process Control Engineering

threat_event: A cyber-initiated deviation defeats safeguards that the PHA treats as independent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PHA 2024 does not consider control system compromise; alarms and some interlocks on the DCS are credited as layers of protection
affected_asset_or_process: Plant C1 chlorine process; Program 2 plants
existing_controls: Independent SIS for the main scenarios
treatment_plan: Add control system compromise as a cause at the next PHA revalidation; check credited safeguards for common failure with the DCS

threat_event: Ransomware at a legacy plant cannot be recovered quickly because OT backups are missing or untested
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No tested OT backups at 5 of the 7 legacy plants
treatment_plan: Offline backups and a restore test at each legacy plant
owner: Specialty Chemicals Vice President of Manufacturing Technology

threat_event: Malware moves from the business network to legacy plant control systems through flat networks and dual-homed historians
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat networks; dual-homed historians; unsupported HMIs; no OT monitoring
treatment_plan: OT standard migration (DMZ, conduits, sensors) by 2027-12-31; remove second network cards first
owner: Specialty Chemicals Vice President of Manufacturing Technology

threat_event: Attacker uses always-on integrator remote desktop tools at two legacy plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on third-party remote tools outside the gateway
treatment_plan: Remove the tools and move the integrators to the gateway by 2026-11-30
owner: Specialty Chemicals Vice President of Manufacturing Technology

threat_event: AI-001 writes a setpoint that drives the hypochlorite reactor toward an unsafe condition
threat_source: Model error; data drift; attacker on the AI path
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Automatic writes from 2026-06 to 2026-09-03 without MOC, safe-limit review, or AI council approval
existing_controls: Bounded ranges; SIS trips; switched back to advisory 2026-09-03
treatment_plan: Remove the write rule; MOC and AI council review before any automatic mode (P10)

threat_event: A recipe change pushed from the hub creates an incompatible mixture in a blend hall
threat_source: Process failure; attacker on the hub
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recipe pushes bypass the plant MOC screen
existing_controls: Two-person recipe approval at the hub
treatment_plan: Staging share and plant MOC for every recipe push

threat_event: Attacker reaches the SIS engineering workstation and disables a safety function
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared SIS EWS account; SIS is on a separate network with read-only status to the DCS; keyswitch required for changes
existing_controls: Separate network; keyswitch; checksum at proof tests
treatment_plan: Named SIS accounts; keyswitch position on the OT monitoring console

threat_event: Changes cannot be traced to a person after an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared integrator and SIS accounts
treatment_plan: Named accounts; DCS event journal to the SIEM

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the Plant C1 historian and OT DMZ servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT DMZ servers reachable from the business side through conduits
existing_controls: EDR on OT DMZ servers; offline backups
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore test of OT DMZ servers

threat_event: At a Program 2 plant, release notification fails because it depends on the business network
threat_source: Network outage during a cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification exercises at Program 2 plants have used office phones
existing_controls: Cellular phones at each control room
treatment_plan: Run the 2026 notification exercises with the business network simulated down

threat_event: Recipes and formulations are copied from plant or hub systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recipe library readable by all hub engineers; no query logging on recipe data in the data platform
treatment_plan: Need-to-know groups for recipe families; logging
owner: Specialty Chemicals Director of Process Control Engineering

threat_event: Unsupported HMIs at legacy plants are exploited with known vulnerabilities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported operating systems that cannot be patched
treatment_plan: Replace with the migration; allowlisting meanwhile
owner: Specialty Chemicals Vice President of Manufacturing Technology

threat_event: Unauthenticated controller protocols are abused on the Plant C1 control network
threat_source: Attacker already inside the control network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy controller protocols lack authentication
existing_controls: Segmentation; OT monitoring alerts on engineering commands
treatment_plan: Accepted with compensating controls until the 2027 DCS upgrade

threat_event: Malware arrives on removable media
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB ports disabled except through the kiosk
treatment_plan: Kiosk use audits quarterly

threat_event: LIMS outage delays certificates of analysis
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single LIMS for all plants
treatment_plan: Accepted; manual workaround in P05

threat_event: A chlorine detector or its alarm path fails without anyone noticing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Detectors on the control network; alarm repeat to the ERC
existing_controls: Monthly bump tests; detector health alarms
treatment_plan: Add detector health to the OT monitoring console

threat_event: A disgruntled operator or engineer manipulates the process
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineering role on all EWS
treatment_plan: Least-privilege engineering roles; journal review

threat_event: Hydrogen peroxide (theft and diversion chemical of interest) is stolen from Plant C1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy CFATS measures still in place; ERP chemical-of-interest tracking
affected_asset_or_process: Plant C1 tank farm and rack
treatment_plan: Keep legacy measures; annual review

threat_event: An integrator laptop brings malware on site
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator laptops not allowed on OT; transient laptops used
treatment_plan: Audit transient laptop use quarterly

threat_event: Tampered historian replica data trains AI-001 to recommend unsafe setpoints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Training data integrity not checked
treatment_plan: Integrity checks on training data (P10)

threat_event: Process data needed for an RMP incident investigation is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DCS keeps 30 days locally; historian backups
treatment_plan: Export journals at incident start (P08)

threat_event: A hurricane damages Plant C1 with chlorine on site and the OT network degraded
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida Gulf location
existing_controls: Hurricane procedure; chlorine cars released before landfall where possible
treatment_plan: Joint hurricane and cyber exercise in 2027

threat_event: The generative formulation assistant leaks formulations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot with a hosted model provider
treatment_plan: Approved projects only (P10)
owner: Specialty Chemicals Director of Process Control Engineering

threat_event: Wireless instruments are added to the control network without review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No wireless today; survey annually
treatment_plan: Add wireless to the MOC cyber screen

threat_event: Tampered controller firmware or vendor media is installed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hashes checked on media; controller firmware integrity not verified
treatment_plan: Firmware integrity checks at the 2027 turnaround

threat_event: Gas alarm repeat to the Group ERC fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alarm repeat uses the WAN
treatment_plan: Heartbeat check on the repeat
